<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
C = len(c[0])
OK = set('GObYW')
def walkable(r, t):
    if r < 0 or t < 0 or r+5 > 58 or t+5 > C: return False
    return all(c[r+i][t+j] in OK for i in range(5) for j in range(5))
start = (40, 34); goal = (30, 14)
q = deque([start]); prev = {start: None}
while q:
    p = q.popleft()
    if p == goal: break
    for dr, dt, name in ((-5,0,'UP'),(5,0,'DOWN'),(0,-5,'LEFT'),(0,5,'RIGHT')):
        np = (p[0]+dr, p[1]+dt)
        if np in prev or np == (20,49): continue
        if walkable(*np):
            prev[np] = (p, name); q.append(np)
path = []; cur = goal
while prev[cur] is not None:
    p, nm = prev[cur]; path.append(nm); cur = p
path.reverse()
full = path + ['DOWN', 'DOWN']
print('path', path, 'full', full)
# check (35,14) window content
for r in range(35, 40):
    print(r, c[r][14:19])
res = action(full)
print({k: res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
print('new pos check:')
cc = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
rs = [i for i in range(len(cc)) for j in range(len(cc[i])) if cc[i][j]=='O']
cs = [j for i in range(len(cc)) for j in range(len(cc[i])) if cc[i][j]=='O']
print('O top-left:', (min(rs), min(cs)) if rs else None)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
